reviews.name: Sunny Kumar
reviews.text: AK Construction Team, especially Nitish Ji, is very customer focused and professional. He listens carefully to customer requirements and makes revisions until complete satisfaction is achieved. I am very happy with their planning and design services. I would highly recommend go with one and only AK construction for your dream home.

reviews.name: Saket Saurabh
reviews.text: Excellent service from Nitish Ji! Delivered precise house plans with smart space optimization, including kitchen, living area, bedroom, and seamless staircase integration. Professional, code-compliant, and ready for approvals. Top-notch work—highly recommend for any home design needs!

reviews.name: Vijay Kumar Das
reviews.text: Had great experience with A K Construction. They were patient with our changing requirements and worked on them enthusiastically. Optimum use of space was done, giving us a sophisticated design for our home. I found them easily reachable for any doubts or questions which I had. They provide a good design and are readily available for advice on best materials to be used for the project.
